name: Lantern Cove Gatehouse — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Twin pearl-stone gateway towers with gold domes, pointed blue/gold window screens, a high open central arch, lanterns/garlands and broad front steps. Tiny iso suggests a repeated gateway group; the central sea view is a key feature. Hidden layout inference: Connect a sheltered cove landing to the gate apron, then pass under the arch toward the principal bridge. Side tower balconies become small lookout pockets rather than closing the harbor vista. Place compact planted strips, lamps and route signs outside the through lane. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B19-DETAIL-001 — Lantern Cove Gatehouse — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need tower/arch springing modules, gate-to-quay/bridge threshold and dome seats. Existing open screens, gold roof and harbor lamp language reused; mirrored tower count/hidden third group requires parity review. Coastal shrubs/grass, seabirds/moths and fish below quay proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
